name: qrdrop-app
description: Tauri desktop/mobile shell for qrdrop. Kept out of the root package.json on purpose -- see CLAUDE.md, "no new runtime dependencies" is a root-package invariant, not an app-directory one. The version above stays 0.0.0 deliberately and is not the app's version: this package is private and never published, the app's version lives in src-tauri/Cargo.toml (which tauri.conf.json reads, which cargo-release bumps, and which the app-v* tag must match), and a second number nothing keeps in step is drift waiting to be believed.
